metadata.title: FENATEVI {year} — Vitória City National Theatre Festival
metadata.description: The {edition}th edition of the Vitória City National Theatre Festival, from {start} to {end}, in Vitória, Brazil. Free admission throughout.

common.externalLinkNotice: Registration takes place on a form outside this site.

intro.line: All it takes is a seed...
intro.hint: Tap or press a key to enter

acessibilidade.title: Accessibility
acessibilidade.description: These three preferences apply across the site and are kept in this browser. They add to whatever your system already asks for — none of them turns an accessibility feature off.

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.hint: Raises the contrast of text and borders, and settles the header and the opening photograph.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.hint: Raises the typographic base of the site. For larger magnification, your browser zoom still works on top of this choice.

motion.label: Motion
motion.hint: Turns off the theatrical opening, the curtain between pages, smooth scrolling and the scroll reveals.

acessibilidade.sessionsNotice: Brazilian Sign Language and audio description are not site settings: they are offered at specific festival sessions. The programme says which ones.

footer.description: Held in Vitória, Espírito Santo, since 2004. This site is also the festival’s permanent archive.

acervo.languageNotice: Archive records — titles, press releases, credits and biographies — are kept in their original language, Brazilian Portuguese.
acervo.demoNoticeBody: The programme for the {edition}th edition has not been published yet. Until then, this site shows the complete archive of the {year} edition.

home.title: FENATEVI
home.subtitle: Vitória City National Theatre Festival

imagens.lenda: The cast of “A Lenda de Um Homem Sem Nome” gathered on stage under a string of lights; at the centre, an actress in a pink lace dress.
imagens.violeta: The actress playing Violeta Parra, with green hair, seated and wrapped in a shawl embroidered in red and pink.
imagens.corpus: Performers in “Corpus Em Vidas” hold a long white cloth above the stage under violet light.
imagens.olhos: A man’s face upside down, lit by a candle flame, in “Meus Olhos Verdes”.
imagens.corpo: A dancer from “O Corpo Que Eu Habito” on stage before a red curtain crossed by ribbons.
imagens.corpo2: A performer in “O Corpo Que Eu Habito” plays the saxophone centre stage, with other dancers behind her.
imagens.charanga: Black-and-white photograph: two masked performers from “A Charanga dos Proscritos” behind a lit table, outdoors.
imagens.dona: Four clowns from “Dona Rua Gentileza” pose before colourful traffic signs; one wears a red shirt with the number 88.
imagens.saga: An actor in “SAGA” opens his arms on stage, wearing a straw and beaded cloak; behind him, another actor wears a white mask.
imagens.homembanda: André Forecchi plays the saxophone in a hat, a bass drum strapped to his back, in “Homem Banda, O Show”.
imagens.metamorfose: A man’s face peers through a gap between patterned fabrics, in sepia, in “A Metamorfose”.
imagens.carambolas: Two actresses from “Carambolas” seated at a table under blue light; one of them is reading a book.
imagens.kala: Two actors from “A Maldição e o Mistério de Kalá” on stage before a wooden wall: he in a blue jacket, she in an embroidered vest.
imagens.calunga: An actor raises a lit puppet before an actress in a yellow dress, in the dark, in “Calunga”.
imagens.divertida: The actor and hypnotist of “Divertida Mente”, in a dark suit, smiles before a red curtain with a glowing brain in his palm.
imagens.boi: The cast of “A História do Boi de Sol” poses with a decorated ox head, in golden costumes and straw hats.
imagens.cabrabo: The large cast of “O Auto de Cabrabó” on stage before the façades of a scenic town, holding up placards.
imagens.couro: The couple in “Couro de Cabra e a Promessa” in profile, forehead to forehead; she in a white dress, he in an embroidered vest.
imagens.avarento: The cast of “O Avarento” in period costume and powdered wigs, around a seated man with a cane.
imagens.homenageadoBere: Portrait of Bere, Luiz Carlos Siqueira, honouree of the 2024 edition.
imagens.homenageadoAlcides: Portrait of Alcides Luiz Rodrigues Pereira, honouree of the 2024 edition.
imagens.capa2024: Cover of the 2024 printed programme, with theatrical masks and the festival name.
imagens.previaSilhuetas: Illustrative photograph: three actors in silhouette against a lit red curtain.
imagens.previaCortina: Illustrative photograph: a closed red velvet curtain over a stage.
imagens.previaPlateiaVazia: Illustrative photograph: the empty auditorium of a historic theatre, seen from the back of the house.
imagens.previaTeatroHistorico: Illustrative photograph: the interior of a historic theatre, with gilded boxes and a red curtain.
imagens.previaPlateiaDoPalco: Illustrative photograph: a full audience seen from the stage during a performance.
imagens.previaCasaCheia: Illustrative photograph: a packed theatre with boxes on several levels.
imagens.previaCorpoEmCena: Illustrative photograph: a dancer in motion, lit against a dark background.
imagens.oficinaDissociando: André Forecchi plays the saxophone with a bass drum and cymbals mounted on his body, at the “Dissociando o Corpo” workshop.
imagens.bethCaser: Portrait of Beth Caser, actress, manager and founder of the festival.
